---
title: "Search PINs and Projects"
page-layout: full
---

Search by full or partial PIN, municipality, township, project key PIN, or appellant. The last column opens the relevant pre-rendered township report.

```{r}
#| label: pin-directory
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(DT)

slugify <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    str_remove("^-") |>
    str_remove("-$")
}

comm_ind <- read_csv("../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/comm_ind_PINs_2011to2022_timeseries.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year == 2022) |>
  select(pin, clean_name, Township, everything()) |>
  mutate(pin10 = str_sub(pin, 1, 10))

keypins <- read_xlsx("../Merriman RA/ptax/Output/projects_checked_MAINFILE.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    keypin = main_keypin,
    pin10 = str_sub(as.character(pin), 1, 10)
  )

pin_directory <- comm_ind |>
  left_join(
    keypins |>
      select(any_of(c("pin10", "keypin", "appellant"))) |>
      distinct(),
    by = "pin10"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    PIN = pin,
    `Project key PIN` = keypin,
    Municipality = clean_name,
    Township,
    Appellant = appellant,
    Report = paste0(
      '<a href="townships/', slugify(Township),
      '-projects.html">Open report</a>'
    )
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(Township, Municipality, PIN)

DT::datatable(
  pin_directory,
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 25,
    searchHighlight = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
)
```
